(The Yellow and Blues) | founded = {{Start date and age|28 December 1919}}{{cite web | url = https://www.nzs.si/tekmovanja/?action=vsiKlubi&id_menu=35 | title = Klubi | trans-title = Clubs | publisher = [[Football Association of Slovenia]] | access-date = 29 July 2016 | language = sl | archive-date = 21 June 2019 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20190621112716/https://www.nzs.si//tekmovanja/?action=vsiKlubi&id_menu=35 | url-status = live }}{{cite web | url = https://www.nk-celje.si/sl/zgodovina | title = Zgodovina | trans-title = History | publisher = NK Celje | access-date = 20 April 2016 | language = sl | archive-date = 20 July 2023 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20230720164912/https://www.nk-celje.si/sl/zgodovina | url-status = live }} (''as SK Celje'') | ground = [[Stadion Z'dežele]] | capacity = 13,059 | chrtitle = President | chairman = Valeriy Kolotilo | mgrtitle = Manager | manager = [[Zoran Zeljković]] | league = [[Slovenian PrvaLiga]] | season = [[2025–26 Slovenian PrvaLiga|2025–26]] | position = Slovenian PrvaLiga, 1st of 10 (champions) | current = | pattern_la1 = | pattern_b1 = _niketrophy5mnpb | pattern_ra1 = | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = _nikestrike1y | leftarm1 = 0080FF | body1 = | rightarm1 = 0080FF | shorts1 = 000055 | socks1 = | pattern_la2 = | pattern_b2 = _niketrophy5soto | pattern_ra2 = | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = | leftarm2 = FF6600 | body2 = FF6600 | rightarm2 = FF6600 | shorts2 = FF6600 | socks2 = FF6600 | website = {{URL|https://www.nk-celje.si/}} }} '''Nogometni klub Celje''' ({{langx|en|Celje Football Club}}), commonly referred to as '''NK Celje''' or simply '''Celje''' ({{IPA|sl|ˈtsɛ̀ːljɛ|}}), is a professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Celje]], Slovenia. Founded in 1919, the club competes in the [[Slovenian PrvaLiga]], the top tier of [[Football in Slovenia|Slovenian football]]. Together with [[NK Maribor|Maribor]], Celje are the only club to have participated in every season of the PrvaLiga since the competition was established in 1991.{{cite web |first=Gordana |last=Possnig |title=V Celju že sto let organizirano igrajo nogomet |url=https://www.vecer.com/v-celju-ze-sto-let-organizirano-igrajo-nogomet-10063074 |website=[[Večer (Slovenia)|Večer]] |date=10 September 2019 |access-date=5 September 2026 |language=sl}} Celje have won the Slovenian championship three times, in [[2019–20 Slovenian PrvaLiga|2019–20]], [[2023–24 Slovenian PrvaLiga|2023–24]] and [[2025–26 Slovenian PrvaLiga|2025–26]], and the [[Slovenian Football Cup]] twice, in [[2004–05 Slovenian Football Cup|2004–05]] and [[2024–25 Slovenian Football Cup|2024–25]]. Before Slovenian independence, the club, then known as Kladivar, won the [[Slovenian Republic Football League|Slovenian Republic League]] and [[Slovenian Republic Football Cup|Slovenian Republic Cup]] in 1963–64 and qualified for the [[Yugoslav Second League]].{{cite news |last=Tamše |first=Rok |title=Hanza in tovariši so spisali zgodovino Kladivarja |url=https://www.delo.si/sport/nogomet/hanza-in-tovarisi-so-spisali-zgodovino-kladivarja |work=[[Delo (newspaper)|Delo]] |date=31 January 2024 |access-date=5 September 2026 |language=sl}} The club's most successful European campaign came in [[2024–25 UEFA Conference League|2024–25]], when Celje became the first Slovenian club to reach the quarter-finals of a major UEFA club competition, losing 4–3 on aggregate to [[ACF Fiorentina|Fiorentina]].{{cite web |title=Celje vs Fiorentina facts |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaconferenceleague/news/0297-1d5b7bd61293-d2773c6427f8-1000--celje-vs-fiorentina-facts/ |publisher=[[UEFA]] |date=24 March 2025 |access-date=5 September 2026}}{{cite web |title=2024/25 Conference League: All the results |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaconferenceleague/news/0290-1bbee2bdd4c2-dac8802cf83b-1000/ |publisher=[[UEFA]] |date=28 May 2025 |access-date=5 September 2026}} In 2026, the club reached the [[2026–27 UEFA Champions League qualifying phase and play-off round|Champions League play-off round]] for the first time and, after elimination by [[SK Slovan Bratislava|Slovan Bratislava]], qualified for the league phase of the [[2026–27 UEFA Europa League]].{{cite web |title=Celje prekratko za Ligo prvakov |url=https://www.nzs.si/podrocja/novinarji/novice/celje-prekratko-za-ligo-prvakov-414659 |publisher=[[Football Association of Slovenia]] |date=26 August 2026 |access-date=5 September 2026 |language=sl}} {{TOC limit|3}}"}}
